entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
Of course. The name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is VF88712.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it works fine. I've just... well, I've changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I really don't use it as much as I thought I would.
I see. So it's not meeting your expectations?
It's just... I feel guilty having spent the money on it. I have some other bills coming up, and I was really hoping I could get that money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
I understand completely. Let me check the purchase date for you. I see here that the item was delivered 22 days ago, on December 15th. Let me just review our official policy for you, one moment.
Okay... I'm really hoping you can help me.
Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've pulled up the policy details here in my knowledge base. It states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 22, you're well within that window. I'm glad we could sort this out with a direct return so you don't have to worry about the hassle of a private resale. I can start that process for you right now.
That is such a relief! Thank you so, so much, David. You have no idea how much I appreciate this.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
